description: Detect SCCs across the import graph and classify cycles by pattern (type-only, junk-drawer, cross-domain, within-domain) to surface appropriate fix suggestions (extract-shared-types, invert-dependency, manual).

requirements.description: Cartographer must detect strongly connected components (SCCs) across the import graph (AC-CYCLE-SCC) and classify each cycle by pattern (AC-CYCLE-CLASSIFY): type-only (imports only type declarations), junk-drawer (node with high in/out degree to many domains), cross-domain (cycle spans domain boundaries), or within-domain (cycle contained within a single domain). Fix suggestions must be ranked per pattern (AC-CYCLE-FIXES): type-only cycles suggest extract-shared-types; cross-domain cycles suggest invert-dependency; junk-drawer and within-domain cycles suggest manual review. Fix suggestions are embedded in the Conflict envelope's suggested_fixes field.
requirements.title: Cycle Detection, SCC Classification, and Fix Suggestion

validation.notes: AC-CYCLE-SCC: Tarjan's or Kosaraju's algorithm correctly identifies a known 3-node SCC in a fixture graph
AC-CYCLE-SCC: A DAG (no cycles) returns an empty SCC set
AC-CYCLE-CLASSIFY: A cycle whose edges are exclusively type imports is classified as type-only
AC-CYCLE-CLASSIFY: A cycle spanning two or more domain boundaries is classified as cross-domain
AC-CYCLE-CLASSIFY: A node with imports to and from ≥3 domains is classified as junk-drawer
AC-CYCLE-CLASSIFY: A cycle fully contained within one domain is classified as within-domain
AC-CYCLE-FIXES: type-only classification produces suggested_fix=extract-shared-types as top suggestion
AC-CYCLE-FIXES: cross-domain classification produces suggested_fix=invert-dependency as top suggestion
AC-CYCLE-FIXES: junk-drawer and within-domain classifications produce suggested_fix=manual
End-to-end: bas/fixtures/go-cycles/ contains a deliberate cross-domain cycle; cartographer detects it, classifies it as cross-domain, and suggests invert-dependency
End-to-end: bas/fixtures/ts-junk-drawer/ contains a junk-drawer node; cartographer detects it and suggests manual review
SCC output is embedded in Conflict envelopes that pass the envelope serialization round-trip test
A developer reviewing a cycle conflict immediately sees its classification and ranked fix suggestions without needing to understand graph theory
Within-domain cycles are surfaced at lower severity than cross-domain cycles by default

title: Cycle Detection and Classification
